take.title_zh: Figma Config 2026：設計工具的 AI 新紀元
take.title_en: Figma Config 2026: AI Redefines the Design Canvas
take.body_zh:
Figma Config 2026（6/23–25，舊金山，8,000+ 人）以「AI 是加速器，設計師是方向舵」為核心，宣布 Figma Motion 原生動畫時間軸、Code Layers（GitHub 直上畫布）、WebGPU 著色器，以及具備 Skills 與 Connectors 的設計 Agent。CEO Dylan Field 宣示：Figma 不跟 text-to-UI 生成工具競爭，而是把畫布打造成協作判斷力的複利平台。

同期，AI 模型競賽也持續升溫。Claude Fable 5（Anthropic，6/9，100 萬 token context）與 Kimi K2.7 Code（Moonshot，6/12）已上線；Gemini 3.5 Pro 與 Grok 5 仍在整備中。對設計師而言，這個月最值得關注的不是哪家模型跑分最高，而是 AI 如何深入整合進工作流程——Config 2026 給出了 Figma 的答案。
take.body_en:
Figma Config 2026 (June 23–25, San Francisco, 8,000+ attendees) was less a feature drop and more a platform declaration. CEO Dylan Field unveiled Figma Motion (native animation timelines), Code Layers (GitHub on canvas), WebGPU shaders, and a design agent with composable Skills and external Connectors. The framing: AI lowers execution barriers, but designers compound judgment and taste on the canvas.

In the broader AI landscape, Anthropic's Claude Fable 5 (1M context, June 9) and Moonshot's Kimi K2.7 Code (June 12) recently landed, with Gemini 3.5 Pro and Grok 5 still pending. For designers, this month's real signal isn't benchmarks — it's how deeply AI is integrating into workflows. Config 2026 is Figma's answer.

articles.title_zh: Figma Config 2026 全解：Motion、Code Layers、WebGPU 著色器與 AI 設計 Agent
articles.title_en: Figma Config 2026: Motion, Code Layers, Shaders & AI Design Agent — Full Recap
articles.summary_zh: Figma Config 2026 於舊金山登場，8,000 位與會者見證了 Figma 最大幅度的平台升級。核心亮點包括：Figma Motion 原生動畫時間軸終結了對 Principle／After Effects 的出圈需求；Code Layers 將 GitHub 版本控管直接嵌入畫布，設計與開發共用同一份真相；WebGPU 著色器開放即時 3D 視覺效果；設計 Agent 具備可組合的 Skills 與外部 Connectors；Aleph 2.0 賦予畫框創意方向感。
articles.summary_en: Figma Config 2026 delivered a sweeping platform upgrade to 8,000 attendees in San Francisco. Highlights: Figma Motion brings native animation timelines (ending the Principle/After Effects detour), Code Layers embed GitHub versioning directly on canvas for a shared design-dev source of truth, WebGPU shaders enable real-time 3D visuals, and the new design agent ships with composable Skills and external Connectors. Aleph 2.0 adds frame-level creative direction to the Weave canvas.
articles.take_zh: Figma 沒有跟生成 UI 工具搶市場，而是把「畫布」升級成具備 AI 代理能力的協作作業系統。設計師的判斷力與系統思維，在 AI 加速執行的時代反而成了稀缺資產。
articles.take_en: Figma isn't chasing text-to-UI generators — it's turning the canvas into an AI-powered collaboration OS. As execution gets cheaper, designer judgment and systems thinking become the scarce resource.

articles.title_zh: Figma 推出專為設計任務打造的 Agentic AI 工具
articles.title_en: Figma Launches an Agentic AI Tool Specifically for Design Tasks
articles.summary_zh: Figma 在 Config 2026 發布針對設計任務的 AI Agent，與通用型 AI 工具不同，此 Agent 能理解設計系統語境、元件層級與品牌規範。設計師可將重複性任務（套用 token、生成變體、整理圖層）委派給 Agent，自身聚焦高層次方向判斷。Agent 支援 Skills 組合與 Connectors 接入外部資料，可串連 CMS 或設計 token 系統，大幅擴展自動化邊界。
articles.summary_en: Figma's new AI agent, launched at Config 2026, is purpose-built for design — it understands design system context, component hierarchy, and brand rules. Designers can delegate repetitive tasks (token application, variant generation, layer cleanup) while retaining creative direction. The agent supports composable Skills and external Connectors, opening paths to CMS and design token system integrations and significantly expanding what can be automated inside Figma.
articles.take_zh: 通用型 AI 不懂設計語境，Figma 的 Agent 直接在設計系統內部操作——這是「AI 協作設計師」和「AI 替代設計師」之間的關鍵分野。
articles.take_en: Generic AI doesn't understand design context. Figma's agent works inside the design system itself — that's the key line between AI-assisted and AI-replaced design.

articles.title_zh: 2026 年 6 月 AI 發布浪潮：Builder 的決策地圖
articles.title_en: June 2026 AI Launch Wave: A Builder's Decision Map
articles.summary_zh: 6 月同步迎來四條模型敘事線：Claude Fable 5（Anthropic，6/9，推理模型、100 萬 token context）與 Kimi K2.7 Code（Moonshot，6/12）已確認上線；Gemini 3.5 Pro 與 Grok 5 仍在整備中（後者 6/30 前上市的 Polymarket 機率僅 12–33%）。文章以 builder 視角整理各模型的適用場景與整合優先序，幫助開發者在密集發布期做出清晰決策。
articles.summary_en: Four model storylines collide in June 2026: Claude Fable 5 (reasoning, 1M context, June 9) and Kimi K2.7 Code (June 12) have landed; Gemini 3.5 Pro and Grok 5 remain pending — Grok 5's pre-June 30 Polymarket odds sit at 12–33%. This piece maps each model's fit for builders by use case, helping developers prioritize integrations during an unusually dense release window.
articles.take_zh: 在 AI 發布密集期，「選哪個模型」不如「為什麼場景選哪個模型」重要。這份決策地圖是設計與產品 builder 此刻需要的導航工具。
articles.take_en: In a dense release window, the right question isn't 'which model' but 'which model for which use case.' This decision map gives builders a clear frame for a noisy month.

articles.title_zh: 軟體的未來是什麼樣子？Figma 的回答
articles.title_en: What Does the Future of Software Look Like?
articles.summary_zh: Figma 官方部落格於 Config 2026 期間發布深度文章，探討「AI 讓軟體本身變成什麼」。核心論點：未來軟體不是更好用的工具，而是能學習使用者意圖並主動適應需求的系統。Figma 以「可組合 AI 工作流」為方向，讓設計師、PM 與工程師可在同一畫布呼叫不同 AI 能力，而非在多個工具之間切換。
articles.summary_en: Published during Config 2026, Figma's team blog argues that the future of software isn't better tools — it's systems that learn user intent and adapt proactively. Figma's direction: composable AI workflows where designers, PMs, and engineers invoke AI capabilities on the same canvas, eliminating context-switching and making cross-functional collaboration the default, not the exception.
articles.take_zh: 「軟體的未來」是個大哉問，但 Figma 給出了具體的設計系統解法：把 AI 嵌進協作層，而不是另建一個 AI 產品。這是平台思維，不是功能思維。
articles.take_en: Rather than launching a separate AI product, Figma embeds AI into the collaboration layer — a platform play with long-term implications for how design and engineering teams work together.

articles.title_zh: 2026 年 6 月 AI 模型發布最新追蹤
articles.summary_zh: AI Flash Report 持續追蹤 6 月各大 AI 模型動態。截至 6/25，Claude Fable 5（Anthropic，推理模型，100 萬 token context，6/9）與 Kimi K2.7 Code（Moonshot，6/12）已確認上線；Gemini 3.5 Pro（Google）與 Grok 5（xAI）仍待發布。整體模型競賽主軸：推理能力、超長 context 與 code 特化持續成為差異化賽道，benchmark 刷新節奏從季度縮短至月度。
articles.summary_en: AI Flash Report's running June 2026 tracker: Claude Fable 5 (Anthropic, reasoning, 1M context, June 9) and Kimi K2.7 Code (Moonshot, June 12) are confirmed live. Gemini 3.5 Pro and Grok 5 (xAI) remain pending. Current differentiation axes: reasoning capability, extended context, and code specialization. The benchmark refresh cycle has compressed from quarterly to monthly.
articles.take_zh: AI 模型發布節奏已從「季度事件」變成「月度常態」，追蹤器的價值在於把雜訊過濾成信號——哪些模型有生產力意義，哪些只是跑分新聞。
articles.take_en: Model releases have shifted from quarterly events to monthly cadence. Trackers like this earn their keep by filtering noise — distinguishing models with real productivity implications from pure benchmark announcements.

articles.title_zh: Figma AI 2026：能做什麼、還做不到什麼
articles.title_en: Figma AI in 2026: Everything It Can Do — and What It Still Can't
articles.summary_zh: LogRocket 對 Figma AI 功能做了全面清點：內容生成、圖片編輯、智慧搜尋、UI 草稿、程式碼交付與全站生成現已齊備。然而 Figma AI 仍存在盲區——對品牌情感調性、跨系統一致性與複雜互動邏輯的理解有限。文章以「可安心委派」vs「仍需人工監督」為框架，幫助設計師制定務實的 AI 委派策略。
articles.summary_en: LogRocket audits Figma AI's full 2026 feature set: content generation, image editing, smart search, UI drafting, code handoff, and full-site creation are all live. Remaining gaps: brand emotional tone, cross-system consistency, and complex interaction logic still require human judgment. Organized as 'ready to delegate' vs 'still supervise,' this is a practical framework for building your AI workflow inside Figma.
articles.take_zh: 知道 AI「不能做」比知道 AI「能做」更有價值——這篇文章把邊界說清楚了，幫設計師少走彎路、少踩坑。
articles.take_en: Knowing what Figma AI can't do is more valuable than knowing what it can. This piece draws the line clearly, saving designers from costly misallocations of trust.

articles.tab_short_zh: UX 設計師 AI 工具
articles.title_zh: 2026 年 UX 設計師最值得用的 AI 工具清單
articles.title_en: Top AI Tools for UX Designers in 2026
articles.summary_zh: Figma 官方整理 2026 年 UX 設計師值得用的 AI 工具清單，涵蓋研究、Wireframe、視覺生成、原型、使用者測試與交付各環節。從 Figma AI、Maze 的 AI 研究分析、Galileo 的 UI 生成，到 Notion AI 的設計文件整理，各工作流階段皆有對應選項。文章強調：工具選擇的關鍵不是「最先進」，而是「最能嵌入現有設計流程」。
articles.summary_en: Figma's official 2026 AI tool roundup covers every UX workflow stage: research, wireframing, visual generation, prototyping, user testing, and handoff. From Figma AI to Maze's AI research analysis, Galileo's UI generation, and Notion AI for design documentation — the guide emphasizes fit over novelty: the best tool is the one that integrates cleanest into your existing process.
articles.take_zh: 這份清單的價值不在於「哪個工具最強」，而在於「各環節有哪些成熟選項可選」——適合每季拿出來重新評估一次。
articles.take_en: The value here isn't ranking the 'best' tool — it's mapping mature options at each workflow stage. Worth revisiting every quarter as the AI tooling landscape shifts.
